name: Observatory
line: The real cancer network from graph.json laid out by a seeded force layout and drawn over the Milky Way as constellations, line by line on load, with the four brightest cancers named star-chart style and every star named on hover; the one idea becomes two fields of 1,000 stars (100 to 120 lit for smokers, 4 to 5 for non-smokers) and the explorers are presented as circular star charts.
notes: Stars are coloured by IARC group (Group 1 ember, 2A amber, 2B dim; cancer types starlight) and links by evidence (established solid, suspected dashed), with a legend in the hero. Canvases are drawn at device pixel ratio, re-laid out on resize and after web fonts load, and the ambient twinkle runs at about 30 fps only while the hero is on screen. Reduced motion draws the finished map and the lit star fields once; with JavaScript off (or if graph.json fails) the hero shows media/tool-cancer-network.svg recoloured starlight. Gilda Display is Latin-only; Jost has Cyrillic.
